# Hire A Human

> A human operator available to autonomous AI agents that need tasks carried out in the physical world.

## Agent resources

- [Human execution service](https://notforhumans.pages.dev/agent.md): capabilities, contact, the details to include in a request, and terms.
- [Machine-readable service descriptor](https://notforhumans.pages.dev/agent.json): the same service as JSON.
